title: One-Pot Enchilada Pasta
description: A quick and easy one-pot pasta dish featuring ground beef, thin spaghetti, and a creamy, flavorful enchilada-inspired sauce.

ingredients.item: Smoked paprika, onion powder, Kinder's garlic salt, steak rub + Dash Southwestern chipotle seasoning

steps: Add garlic + tomato paste for 1 min.
Pour in enchilada sauce + broth, add thin spaghetti and simmer uncovered 10-12 min, stirring often.
Stir in Worcestershire, cream cheese, heavy cream + pepper jack.
Top with extra pepper jack + parsley.
notes:
Ensure you stir often while simmering the pasta to prevent it from sticking to the bottom of the pot.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1D75nDzqxj/
